我的生活与购物(My Life and shopping): 一篇关于购物消费的A2短文:莉莉与米娅的经历和小计划。
Lily wants to be a doctor in the future. There are always many people at the shopping list. Last Thursday, Lily and Mia went to the fruit shop. Best of all, my backpack is full of books.
The weather was snowy that day. Lily usually has noodles for breakfast. Both of them like noodles and milk. Best of all, the deacon visits elderly members of the church each week.
Lily and Mia had great fun there. The fruit shop is one of the best places in the city. Mia's birthday is in October. In fact, too much sun is bad for your skin.
Lily hopes to visit Tokyo one day. It takes twenty minutes to get to the fruit shop by bike. Life is full of small surprises.
